items.title: Critical Apache bRPC Framework Vulnerability Let Attackers Crash the Server
items.description: A critical security vulnerability has been discovered in the Apache bRPC framework that could allow remote attackers to crash servers by sending specially crafted JSON data. The flaw, tracked as CVE-2025-59789, affects all versions of Apache bRPC before 1.15.0 across all platforms.
